intro: On Westfall's coast, Old Murk-Eye terrorizes the shore. Captain Grayson, the ghost at Westfall Lighthouse, needs a scale from the murloc as proof of his death.

p: Old Murk-Eye turned Westfall's coast into a killing ground. Captain Grayson, the ghost bound to Westfall Lighthouse, says the cunning murloc rallied weaker-minded murlocs to raid the shore. Murk-Eye drove away the keeper's family, leaving the beacon dark when Grayson's ship struck the rocks. When the family returned to relight the flame, Murk-Eye attacked again and slaughtered them. Grayson seeks a scale from the creature as proof that the shore is clear of its fiercest predator.
